§3§lInput in Order as One Group§r
Multiple matrix compartments act as §1one unit§r. Starting at the §1ME entry point§r, they receive items and fluids in §1pattern order§r.

§3§lRepeated Materials Stay Separate§r
For example, with a pattern of §1A/B/B/C§r, four item compartments receive §1A, B, B and C§r in order. The two B inputs stay separate.

§3§lPlacement and Connection§r
Place compartments of the same type in a §1straight line, all facing the same way§r, §1horizontally or vertically§r. Use only §1one ME entry§r for the whole group.
